title: Foundation
description: Founded in Gurugram by Pradeep Sharma, Manmohan Jindal and the late Rajeev Gupta.

title: Industrial HVAC
description: Established Unique as an industrial HVAC engineering and contracting firm, with works for NTPC, BHEL and Rolls-Royce Power Engineering.

title: Beyond North India
description: Expanded beyond North India, adding AHU and air-washer manufacturing and delivering projects for stadiums, hotels and Commonwealth Games infrastructure. Unique became recognised nationwide for HVAC.

title: Complete MEPF and BMS
description: Expanded into complete MEPF and BMS, supporting industrial plants for Coca-Cola, Barco, Oriflame, Belco Pharma, ITC and Luxottica; healthcare campuses under AIIMS and PMSSY; and Mopa International Airport.

title: Advanced industry
description: Established a foothold in advanced industries with complete MEPF and BMS for Foxconn and Tata Electronics, and for STT, CtrlS and AdaniConneX data centres.

title: The next foothold
description: Establish the same foothold in civil, solar and precision engineering, alongside 33 active programmes across data centres, semiconductors and commercial MEP.
